comparison.objective: Mount and lock an inverted zoom lens, set it to 50 mm, and verify passive retention.
comparison.physical_skill: Bayonet alignment, pin locking, zoom-ring adjustment, and inverted retention handling.
comparison.success_condition: Lens remains locked and at 48–52 mm for 20 seconds after release.
comparison.reason: Although both preserve a setting, this tests selection/mounting and passive ring friction rather than two-tool jam-nut countertorque plus repeated mechanism cycling.
